title: docs(skills): the lint table and the repeater row name the parent field group, not inlineEdit
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XC63go34oEMBFaBgqpoDC8N)_
Fixes #36252
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:照着数据技能里的「检查规则表」写应用的作者和 AI,以前读到的是「明细子表没开行内编辑就会被提示」,而检查实际看的是「主表有没有用字段分组把明细放进表单」;现在这三条规则,以及字段类型表里「可重复项」那一行,都按实际判断来写。
- 为什么做:属于「对外发布的技能包教的内容要和运行时一致」这条线,替按技能生成应用的作者和 AI 解决「去调一个已经不起作用的开关、却猜不到检查什么时候报」的问题。
- 出错会怎样:只改技能文字和一条变更说明,不动检查本身;写错的话作者读到的仍是一段不准的说明,直接回退这个 PR 即可。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

State at head `a5ea2daa9` (one commit on `origin/main` `c30ce97cd`). Text only, in the published catalog; the rule ids and the lint are unchanged.

`skills/objectstack-data/references/lint-rules.md`, the three "Catches" cells:

- `relationship/line-items-inline-edit`: was "a `*_line`/`*_item` master_detail child without `inlineEdit`"; now "a `*_line`/`*_item` master_detail child placed by no parent field group (`fieldGroups[].relatedList`)".
- `relationship/inline-edit-needs-bulk`: was "`inlineEdit` while the parent's or child's `enable.apiMethods` omits `'bulk'`"; now "a child a group places while the parent's or child's `enable.apiMethods` omits `'bulk'`".
- `relationship/association-inline-edit`: was "an association (comment/audit/activity) marked `inlineEdit` (clutters the parent form — use a detail-page related list)"; now "an association (comment/audit/activity) a group places (leave it a tab)".

`skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md`, seat-added scope (seat comment 7073941454 on PR #36250), the `repeater` row: "a typed list is a child object (`master_detail`, `inlineEdit: 'grid'`)" becomes "a typed list is a `master_detail` child a parent `fieldGroups[].relatedList` names". Three punctuation trims in the same section pay for it (the section's intro line and the `composite` and `repeater` rows: an em dash becomes a comma or a colon, two spaced slashes close up); no teaching is removed.

Changeset `.changeset/36252-lint-rules-field-group.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch.

This agrees with the rule that PR #36250 teaches in `rules/relationships.md`: a parent field group naming the child places it in the record details and the entry form, and `inlineEdit` only picks how the rows are edited.

<details><summary>Each claim against the lint source (origin/main c30ce97cd)</summary>

- None of the three rules reads `inlineEdit`. In `packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts` the word occurs only in comments and in one unrelated `fix` string (see Acceptance notes).
- R5, `relationship/line-items-inline-edit` (severity `suggestion`): fires on a `master_detail` field of an object whose name matches `LINE_ITEM_RE` when `isGroupPlaceableRelationship(def)` holds and `formInlines(...)` is false. `formInlines` is `isGroupPlaceableRelationship(def)` and `fieldGroupsPlaceRelationship(parent.fieldGroups, child, field)`, which reads each parent group's `relatedList` (a bare child name, or `object.field`). Its `fix` line adds a `relatedList` group to the parent's `fieldGroups`.
- `lintInlineEditBulk`, `relationship/inline-edit-needs-bulk` (severity `warning`): for every group-placeable relationship that a parent field group places, it warns once per object, parent or child, whose declared `enable.apiMethods` does not allow `bulk`.
- R6, `relationship/association-inline-edit` (severity `warning`): fires on a relationship of an association-named object when `formInlines(...)` is true, i.e. a parent field group places it. Its message says to leave it a tab of the record page; its `fix` removes the group.
- `repeater` row: the spec's own route sentence for a typed list (`EMBEDDED_JSON_TYPED_LIST` in `packages/spec/src/data/authoring-key-lint.ts`) reads: a child object whose `master_detail` field points back at this object; a field group on this object whose `relatedList` names that child edits its rows as an inline grid on this object's form.

</details>

## Evals

No eval case pins the old wording, so none is changed. Searched `skills/*/evals/*.json` for the three rule ids, for the old cell wording, and for `repeater` and "typed list": zero hits. Three cases mention `inlineEdit` for other reasons (objectstack-data case 2 and objectstack-ui views case 6, both rewritten by PR #36250; objectstack-ui record-page case 1, see Acceptance notes). No eval round was run (a round is the eval seat's).

## Tests

All readings at head `a5ea2daa9`.

All 48 ran under `os-verify-lock.sh`; 43 answered exit 0 on the first pass, and 5 answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, nothing built yet): `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`. After `pnpm build` (120 tasks successful) the same five commands answered exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- Precision limit, declared: the `line-items-inline-edit` cell does not spell the rule's one precondition, that the FK is one a group may place. A line-item FK that itself declares `relatedList: true` or `false` is never flagged, because a group naming it would be refused. The cell stays at the table's summary level, like its `*_line`/`*_item` shorthand for the ten suffixes the lint matches.
- The `line-items-inline-edit` cell uses the file's one byte of headroom (3735 to 3736 bytes, 934 tokens either way). The `field-types.md` edit is one byte smaller than before, so PR #36158's measured row for that file cannot be pushed up by this change.
- Out of scope, not changed here (lint source): `packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts`, the `fix` line of `field/embedded-sub-fields`, still says to make the typed list a child object and that `inlineEdit: 'grid'` edits it inline. The spec's route sentence and that rule's explanation text already name the parent field group. Read, not run.
- Out of scope, not changed here (skills, same family): `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` § Detail-page related lists and `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md` item 2 still teach that a `master_detail` child with no `relatedList` is a body table by default, and objectstack-ui eval `record-page.json` case 1 expects that answer. `packages/spec/src/data/related-list-body-table.ts` says it is a tab by default and a body table only when a parent field group names it. Read against the spec source, not run.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `skills/objectstack-data/references/lint-rules.md`, the three changed rows (the published claim about when each rule fires).
2. `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md`, the `repeater` row and the two byte-paying lines beside it.
3. `.changeset/36252-lint-rules-field-group.md`.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` exits 0 and prints `lint-rules.md 934 / 934 (+0)` and `field-types.md 3541 / 3541 (+0)`; then `grep -c "inlineEdit" skills/objectstack-data/references/lint-rules.md` prints `0` (it printed `3` on `origin/main` `c30ce97cd`; the rule ids are spelled `inline-edit` and are unchanged).
